fluff.overview: Under the reforms of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht, Com Guard infantry train extensively in combined-arms cooperation, conducting regular exercises alongside heavier elements to ensure seamless coordination across all branches when battle demands it. Mechanized hover Level I formations are the fastest ground-mobile infantry in the Com Guards, using hovercraft APCs that can cross water obstacles and open terrain at speeds no wheeled or tracked transport can match. Their speed makes them valuable for flanking maneuvers and rapid exploitation of breakthroughs. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these troops deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
